expectedLines.text: Operations coordinator with six years in logistics and customer service. I like turning messy processes into simple routines and measuring whether they work.
Harbourline Logistics · Milwaukee, WI · Apr 2021 – Present
• Built 6 Excel dashboards that the depot uses every morning to plan 40 delivery routes
• Reduced late deliveries from 9% to 4% by changing the loading order and cut-off times
• Coordinated 3 carriers and 12 drivers during the peak season
• Introduced a weekly review of delivery data with the dispatch team
• Led a team of 7 agents handling 400 orders and complaints a day
• Raised customer satisfaction from 86% to 93% in 18 months
• Wrote 30 help articles that reduced repeat contacts by 15%
Corner Roast Café · Madison, WI · Sep 2016 – Jan 2018
• Served up to 250 customers per shift
Personal project with public city traffic data.
• Analyzed 18 months of delivery times with SQL and Power BI and found 3 avoidable delay patterns
• Planned weekly routes for 9 volunteer drivers serving 120 families
Tools: Excel (pivot tables, XLOOKUP), Power BI, SQL (basic), Google Workspace
Methods: Process improvement, Lean basics, Stakeholder communication
